caption: Callum becomes a potato, and the whole Titanic Club is spud-based. Now onto our grandest adventure!

caption: Enda, Annelisa, Rosie, Joe, Connor, Natasha, Rhianna, Callum and Leon.

caption: Weeeee! Then a dark, closed airport and some rough taxi drivers only a maman could love.

caption: “Umm… which taxi do we get?”

caption: Tash summons two Ubers through the dark streets of Lyon; then burgers, pizza, bunk beds, and a scolding for pinball at 1am.

caption: “Oui, oui!” in one car, “Non, non!” in the other.

caption: “Pinball?! Non! NON!” from Le Reception.

caption: After a gentle snooze, the Titanic Club rolled to the nearest patisserie for sensational pastries.

caption: “You mean, they eat the flutes here?”

caption: The first Uber driver drops some of the club at the closest place to the car rental place: the centre of the road. RUUUN!

caption: Driver: “This is where you have to get out.”

caption: The Titanic Club waiting in the back of the Uber.

caption: Quickly, they ran to safety, like adrenaline-soaked chickens…

caption: “Your original destination, or for no reason whatsoever, the Lyon train station?” We kid you not, Ranna chose the train station!

title: Hey madam
caption: “Hey madam… want to go to the train station?”

title: Le car hire
caption: “Ye, go on.” Wait, STOP!

caption: Up the lift to the car hire, while the rest wait below.

title: Still waiting
caption: The clock ticks on outside the car hire.

title: Held hostage?
caption: Annelisa and Enda disappeared after going up the lift for the car hire, leaving some to wonder if they were being held hostage.

title: VROOOOM
caption: With the car now fully booked, the families cheered as Enda hit the accelerator… “Here we go!”

title: At the wheel
caption: Spud Enda, glasses on, behind the wheel.

title: BAAM
caption: …and promptly crashed into the barrier of the car park! Five minutes later: hoo boy, these local drivers sure do have a bee in their bonnet!

title: Today's driving forecast
caption: The dial runs Easy, Tough… French.

title: A local up ahead
caption: The car heads straight for a green local at the roadside.

caption: Up ahead! A local, going about their day in the streets of Lyon. Shame the wing mirror almost knocked their head off when Enda forgot the width of the new vehicle.

title: Close shave
caption: The green local, right beside the mirror.

caption: Displaying full crisis control, Joe froze and hoped everything would just pan out. Meanwhile, Enda focused on the road ahead.

title: Joe froze
caption: “Runnnnn…”

title: BRUNNN
caption: The local, the wing mirror, and a very worried passenger.

title: Eyes on the road
caption: BRUNNN! Meanwhile, spud Enda hums along at the wheel.

title: One hour later
caption: Balloons and a #1 trophy.

title: French number plates
caption: “I just realised all the cars here have French number plates!”

caption: One hour later: French number plates, a random tyre hitting the car (“It'll come off in the wash!”), and some firm advice from the back seat.

caption: The minibus takes a tyre to the side.

title: Back-seat drivers
caption: “Drive on the RIGHT, Enda.”

caption: The advice gets louder.

caption: The minibus always stalled in first gear.

caption: “Oops, that silly first gear…” HONK HONK HONK.

caption: A sweating spud Enda grips the wheel.

caption: 2022's Navigation Award goes to Annelisa Christensen!

caption: Down the lane: a tick, a skull and crossbones, and a fire by the road.

title: Yeah, we do
caption: “Yeah, we do.”

caption: The pink van laughing all the way.

caption: “Madam, shall we drive through this motorway?” “Ye.” Le danger!

caption: Artist's representation of when a driver cut in front of the minibus on the motorway.

caption: Joe squeezed his bag so hard, he left claw marks. Meanwhile, Enda was totally fine.

title: The pink van driver
caption: Who's behind the wheel of the pink van.

caption: One hour later: “1 hour without an incident! Oh look, nuclear towers! And a log truck!” This happened. After the comparison to Final Destination 2 was made, Enda accelerated to safety.

title: AAAH! FLOOR IT!
caption: The pink minibus, mid-panic.

caption: Delirious laughter continued. One hour later: the strict instruction was DON'T lose the ticket. “Oh, shit.” Beep beep, the random HGV convoys in the villages.

caption: The toll barrier, One Hour Later, and “Oh, shit.”

caption: “Rhianna, how are you?” “Reading for my life.”

caption: French Village Edition: beep beep, the random HGV convoys.

caption: “Do you need a break?” LE SERVICES 100,000 m. “I'm like a frog in boiling water!” Meanwhile, Enda was totally fine.

caption: Meanwhile, Enda was totally fine.

caption: Speaking French-ish to the locals proved challenging. “Un pizza plz?” “WHAT?!” Five minutes later: OMG.

caption: The minibus drives past a hillside on fire.

caption: Satnav: “Hey, you want a more adventurous route? Recalculating journey…” Satnav: “:)”

caption: The Satnav took the Titanic Club the wrong way, up a single track mountain, in the direction of the forest fire.

caption: The minibus winds up towards the flames. AHHHHH!

title: Totally fine
caption: A sweating, screaming spud Enda. Meanwhile, Enda was totally fine.

caption: The random exclamation sign without any context.

caption: Peering out of the window, and the pink minibus on the forest road from above.
